mechanism_narrative: The persistent four-week decline in TRANSIT from -42.6 to -52.6 signals reduced commuting and discretionary travel; because retail footfall depends on transit-linked trips, RETAIL_REC will continue to fall over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -50.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS falling below -20% from baseline marks a shift from outdoor summer activity to indoor or restricted routines; this removes park-adjacent retail footfall within one week, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next week.
failure_condition: If PARKS is below -20 but RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is equal to or higher than over the last 7 days, the threshold mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High RESIDENTIAL (+6.6) and low WORKPLACES (-38.0) jointly indicate a home-confinement regime; their interaction suppresses retail-and-recreation trips beyond either alone, driving RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks while RESIDENTIAL stays above +5 and WORKPLACES stays below -35, the interaction claim is false.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, concurrent declines in TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM reflect reduced permitted movement and essential-only shopping; this policy regime keeps RETAIL_REC depressed for four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 5 points in a week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean exceeds last-28-day mean while TRANSIT remains below -50 and GROCERY_PHARM below -25, the regime-conditional claim is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mobility above +5 indicates stay-at-home fatigue is accumulating; as residents exhaust home routines, pent-up demand for retail and recreation produces a rebound over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is lower than or equal to last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above +5.

mechanism_narrative: A PARKS value below -20 signals the end of summer outdoor mobility; this seasonal transition reduces footfall near parks and adjacent retail, pulling RETAIL_REC down over two weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over next 14 days is higher than over last 14 days when PARKS has fallen below -20, the seasonal threshold mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES creates a commuting collapse; retail areas dependent on office workers lose footfall, driving RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over next 28 days while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below their t-0 levels, the interaction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If a reopening regime begins, indicated by TRANSIT rising above -50 and PARKS recovering above -15, retail traffic recovers as restrictions lift; RETAIL_REC rises over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -50 and PARKS rises above -15
failure_condition: If TRANSIT rises above -50 and PARKS above -15 but RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean does not exceed last-28-day mean, the reopening mechanism is false.
